server.connectCommand: tmux new-session -A -s fin-agentd \; set status off

task: Watch the build in this terminal; if it fails, summarize the first error. When the build has finished successfully, end your reply with TASK COMPLETE.

supervision._note: Presigned URLs MUST be SigV4 — boto3 Config(signature_version='s3v4'). A SigV2 URL 403s any PUT because the daemon sends a Content-Type header.

controlPlane._note: Optional. Present, request-input and task-complete events become APNs pushes via the control plane's POST /notify; absent, the daemon stays silent. The token is ~/.fin-control-plane-token on the deploy machine.
